Trim whitespace from the display name in the profile form

1. SUMMARY
==========
The profile form saves display names with leading and trailing spaces.

2. REQUIREMENTS
===============
- Display names must be trimmed before they are saved.

3. ROOT CAUSE
=============
Confirmed: handleNameBlur stores the raw input value.

4. PROPOSED SOLUTION
====================
Trim the value in handleNameBlur before saving.
